claims.statement: For a fixed pair of supplied K-state probe kernels with permutation-orbit Frobenius gap Gamma>0, an unknown shared full-rank categorical reporter E, start occupancy floor p_*, and a uniform history- and start-state-conditional per-block disturbance envelope q_phys<=p_* min(1,Gamma)/768, the pre-read cohort can be used to certify unknown emission clusters and estimate the probe transition matrix up to permutation with error below Gamma/2 using O(kappa^-2) repeated-read frames up to fixed-pair factors and logarithms.
assumptions: Known K and supplied candidate kernels
Every initial-state mass is at least supplied or certified p_*>0
Same-state emissions are iid categorical and invariant across all blocks/actions
Every slow block has uniform conditional jump risk q_phys, including ramps and read backaction
Finite maximum frame cap; abstain if observable cluster certificate fails
claims.novelty: UNKNOWN; component tools are prior art and the composition has not been externally reviewed
claims.costs: For K=3, p_*=1/3, Gamma=.20900495, alpha=.05, kappa=.1, Delta=.01 s: N_t=294411, 588822 blocks, 308712308736 frames, 97.825 years held-read time excluding ramps and all setup/control/recovery costs; q_phys<=9.0714e-5, scalar rho<=1.7303e-9 if q_ramp=0 and Lambda=10/s.
claims.falsifier: A matched physical assay measurement shows the uniform state/history/ramp jump envelope exceeds the bound, emissions drift or depend on action, occupancy fails, or the observed center certificate does not pass.
claims.runtime: Observed-center tuple enumeration: O(binomial(N_t,K) N_t K); permutation orbit gap computation from supplied candidate matrices: O(K! K^2). This is a correctness certificate, not a scalable algorithm.
claims.input_certification_cost: Theorem conditions on one-sided p_* and q_phys certificates and supplied candidate kernels. If p_* or q_phys is acquired in a pilot, allocate confidence separately and charge every founder, read, ramp, and analysis; no such physical certificate is supplied.
claims.next_gate: Find one named system with action-invariant full-rank emissions and a one-sided, all-state, all-history, ramp-inclusive q_phys confidence bound below p_* min(1,Gamma)/768, then compare full likelihood under matched read dose and wall time.

claims.statement: For a known reporter W_kappa=kappa I+(1-kappa)U, uniform stationary initial law, and any adaptive policy over doubly stochastic candidate transition kernels with Dobrushin coefficient at most fixed r<1, full-transcript KL is at most 8 K^3 n kappa^4 (r/(1-r))^2, forcing Omega(kappa^-4) observations for fixed-error testing.
assumptions: Known K, emission W_kappa, candidate kernels, and uniform initial law
All legal action kernels are doubly stochastic and have coefficient bounded by r<1 independent of kappa
The same randomized history-dependent control policy is used in both worlds
Positive emissions with per-symbol lower bound from kappa<=1/2
claims.novelty: UNKNOWN; Dobrushin filter contraction is prior art; exact kappa^4 adaptive transcript bound is internally derived
claims.costs: n observations lower bounded by (1-2delta)^2(1-r)^2/(4K^3 r^2 kappa^4); walltime and photon dose require actual per-read cost
claims.falsifier: Within the declared class, exhibit an action policy with fixed r<1 and a full-likelihood error guarantee using o(kappa^-4) outputs; a cadence with r approaching 1 is outside the claim.
